actions.expression: (() => { const h1s=[...document.querySelectorAll('h1')].map(h=>h.textContent.trim()); const label=[...document.querySelectorAll('span')].find(s=>s.textContent.trim()==='Fulfillment Reference'); const pane=label? label.closest('div').parentElement : null; const p=pane? pane.querySelector('p') : null; const ids=p? [...p.querySelectorAll('span[id^="verse-"]')].map(s=>s.id) : []; const txt=p? p.innerText : ''; return JSON.stringify({ h1s, fulfillmentLabelFound: !!label, paragraphCount: pane? pane.querySelectorAll('p').length : null, verseSpanIds: ids, distinctBooks: [...new Set(ids.map(i=>i.split('-')[0]))], paragraphText: txt.replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,420) }); })()
